svg.text: Re-check Microsoft's profile repository quarterly and refresh profiles that changed. The onboarding package is tenant-specific: a tenant rebuild means offboarding and re-onboarding every Mac.

svg.text: 6 rungs, 5 fixes; 8 profiles Succeeded and 1 app Installed per Mac before the portal check. Controls: SI-3, SI-4 (protection and monitoring in place), CM-6 (configuration verified).
